hooks.text: 从零组装战车，组合喷火器、炮塔、医疗站、引擎与装甲
hooks.excerpt: Completely customize your rig from the ground up with a huge range of components such as flamethrowers, sniper turrets, gatling guns, lookout towers, medical stations, wheels, engines, armor and so much more.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 边驾驶躲避沙虫与环境危险，边调度船员开火、修车和救治
hooks.excerpt: Combat will require you to multitask under pressure! While out on a mission, you must strategize and manage your crew members efficiently to man guns, repair your rig, heal injured crew mates and more. All whilst you drive and navigate environmental hazards and gigantic sandworms.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 四个敌对派系拥有不同武器战术，路线与战斗决策会改变地区控制权
hooks.excerpt: The Gun Nutz, Pyros, Vultures and Klowns are the savage militia groups that roam the Badlands, each led by a crazed Warlord boss. As you progress, you’ll need to plan, adapt and change your tactics as each enemy faction possesses unique weaponry and combat strategies. Approach the campaign how you want! Your decisions influence control as faction influence shifts throughout the campaign. Smart decision-making in the heat of battle and planning routes is imperative to ensure you achieve victory while fighting to seize enemy strongholds and outposts.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
